create_graph_from_text: create a GTN graph from an array of text lines by writing to a temp file and loading with gtn.loadtxt
test_create_graph_from_text: test the create_graph_from_text function by passing an array of graph definition text lines
review_create_graph_from_text: review the create_graph_from_text function that writes text lines to a temp file and loads a GTN graph
refactor_create_graph_from_text: refactor create_graph_from_text to accept a file path instead of writing to a temporary file
summarize_create_graph_from_text: summarize the create_graph_from_text helper that converts text arrays into GTN graph objects via gtn.loadtxt
